title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
script:
Twenty thousand people just placed preorders for the new Microduck robots. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang recently showcased the tiny machines.
The robots were seen stomping their feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises during the demonstration.
These units represent a new wave of interactive AI hardware entering the consumer market.
Huang played with the robots on stage as they moved across the workspace.
Demand for this compact robotics platform is surging ahead of the winter holidays.
Would you want one of these robots on your desk?

editor.one_line: Strong reporting, but the visuals are repetitive, static, and lack actual product footage.
script_fixes: LINE 3: Replace 'These units represent a new wave of interactive AI hardware' with 'The Microduck is the first consumer robot powered by Nvidia's Jetson Orin platform.'
visual_notes: line 1: Same image held for 7+ seconds across multiple frames.
line 2: Visuals are generic logos rather than showing the robots stomping or making noises.
line 3: Static text-only background is boring and lacks visual engagement.
line 4: No footage of Huang actually demoing the robots, just text on a plain background.
line 5: Repetitive text-only frames for the final point.
